name: wasm-tools
description: wasm-tools — WebAssembly toolchain CLI. Parse, validate, demangle, and convert WASM binaries. Includes wasm2wat, wat2wasm, wasm-validate.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/releases/download/v1.248.0/wasm-tools-1.248.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz && tar xzf wasm-tools-1.248.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz && sudo mv wasm-tools /usr/local/bin/ && rm wasm-tools-1.248.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or cargo install.

commands.description: wasm-tools — WebAssembly toolchain CLI. Parse, validate, demangle, and convert WASM binaries. Includes wasm2wat, wat2wasm, wasm-validate.
